item.title: What Marketing Really Is — and What It Is Not
item.description: Learn marketing that actually reaches people: know your customer, say something clear, and build a simple plan you can keep up. Lesson 1: What Marketing Really Is — and What It Is Not This lesson teaches what marketing actually is, so you can stop guessing and start doing the parts that matter.…

item.title: Knowing Your Customer
item.description: Lesson 2: Knowing Your Customer This lesson teaches you to describe your customer in concrete detail, because every marketing decision — where to show up, what to say, what to offer — depends on knowing who you are talking to. By the end you will write a customer profile that a stranger could read…

item.title: Positioning and Messaging
item.description: Lesson 3: Positioning and Messaging This lesson teaches positioning and messaging: how to explain what makes your offer different in a way that matters to the customer, and how to turn that into words you can use everywhere. Positioning is the place your offer occupies in the customer's mind…

item.title: Content That Earns Attention
item.description: Lesson 4: Content That Earns Attention This lesson teaches content marketing: creating useful material that earns attention instead of demanding it. By the end you will know what makes content worth consuming, how to generate topics your customer actually wants, and how to publish consistently with…

item.title: Email Basics
item.description: Lesson 5: Email Basics This lesson teaches email marketing: building a list of people who asked to hear from you and writing emails they actually open. By the end you will create a signup offer, set up a simple welcome sequence, write emails using a proven structure, and follow the basic rules that…

item.title: Social Media Basics
item.description: Lesson 6: Social Media Basics This lesson teaches social media marketing: using social platforms to reach your customer, earn their attention, and build a following that compounds. By the end you will choose the right platforms, set up profiles that turn visitors into followers, create a…

item.title: Measuring What Works
item.description: Lesson 7: Measuring What Works This lesson teaches measurement: tracking what your marketing does so you can do more of what works and stop spending time — or money — on what does not. By the end you will set up basic tracking, read the few numbers that matter, run simple comparisons between…

item.title: Your Simple 30-Day Marketing Plan
item.description: Lesson 8: Your Simple 30-Day Marketing Plan This final lesson assembles everything into a simple 30-day marketing plan and maps where you go from here.
